title: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Amendment Act 1997

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXIX OF 1997
ACT XXIX OF 1997
PAKISTAN STANDARDS
AND QUALITY CONTROL AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act to amend the Pakistan
Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 28th August, 1997]
No.F.9(23)/97‑Legis., dated
28‑8‑1997.‑‑The following Act of Majlish‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 22nd
August, 1997, is hereby published for general information:‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 (VI of 1996),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(I) This Act may be called the Pakistan
Standards and Quality Control Authority (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of Pakistan,

No.F.9(23)/97‑Legis., dated
28‑8‑1997.‑‑The following Act of Majlish‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 22nd
August, 1997, is hereby published for general information:‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 (VI of 1996),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 5, Act
VI of 1996.‑‑In the Pakistan Standards and Quality Control
Authority Act, 1996 (VI of 1996), hereinafter referred as the said Act, in
section 5, in subsection (1, in clause (i), for the word "Industries"
the words "Science and Technology" shall be substituted.
